title: RESONANCE LIMIT
author: hugz202 (AE-analog-four-mods); MKII port: Iced-Cream
description: FUNC + OSC1 (SOUND SETUP) gets a checkbox under OSCILLATOR DRIFT and F1 RESONANCE BOOST: RESONANCE LIMIT. With it on, the track's filter resonances are scaled, F1 RES 0..127 playing as 0..80 and F2 RES as 0..64, after the knob, p-locks, LFOs and envelopes are added, so the whole knob travel stays usable and the filters stay out of self-oscillation. The setting is per synth track and kept with the kit, in core-a4mk2's mod storage (4 of the kit's 128 bits), so it combines with dist and wave; it does not follow a sound into the sound pool or a copy, and it takes no locks. Needs core-a4mk2 0.7. Port of AE-analog-four-mods 0012-res-limit (Analog Four MK1).
